source.caption: The separate 60-statement panel. S is search, O an ordinary early-stop proof attempt, and W a proof attempt that must supply a counterexample. Confirmed-objection counts use the same reference-assisted grader. Ratios compare accepted-attempt token sums. Recorded total tokens are uncached input, cached input, and output (with reported reasoning counted once within output), including reported Opus auxiliary usage. Brackets are pointwise paired 95% intervals; output uses 2,000 resamples and recorded totals 20,000.
